content: <thought>After comparing the simulated 13C NMR of the first candidate with the experimental data, the number and positions of carbon signals do not match (the simulation shows 14 distinct carbons, while the experiment shows only 12 signals with characteristic aliphatic shifts around 44, 34, and 26 ppm). I will test another plausible isomer from the list that contains a phenolic oxygen and a partially saturated ring, which is more consistent with the observed aliphatic carbon chemical shifts.
